name: elohim
description: Cross-cutting elohim-pillar declarations — signal_kinds that span pillars and substrate-level coordination primitives.

forget-request.description: Right-to-be-forgotten request flowing through the EPR feedback pipeline. Mishpat governance evaluates the request against constitutional constraints and emits an attestation:forget-decision. See observation-event-layer spec §9.4.

rate-limit-exceeded.description: Subject exceeded the rate-per-hour bound of a delegates-compute Commitment. Emitted by the substrate-side bounds_validator when validate() returns RateLimitExceeded.

bad-custody.description: Subject violated key-custody discipline — e.g., used a revoked or rotation-stale Commitment, or signed with a non-recipient key. Heaviest weight in the bounds-validator violation set.

reach-escalation-pending.description: Subject attempted a reach above the active project-epr commitment's expected_reach. Soft-warn per §3 of the Z.D substrate-correct deploy spec; serving pauses until operator-steward acknowledgement.

compute-breach.description: Substrate-detected breach of a compute-class Commitment — e.g., excessive resource consumption, attempted scope expansion. Reserved for future per-instance compute-bound validators (Sprint 5a-e).

contention-breach.description: Cross-surface regime-drift breach over an EPR's lens market — an incumbent lens's affinity decayed AND contention (controversy spread) rose together (folds::lens_selector::classify_regime). NOT a punishment signal: it opens a fresh-lens R&D bounty (contention→renewal), so standing-impact is advisory. See plural-mishpat-lenses-over-epr-design §8.

reciprocity-imbalance.description: Provider-dwelling-hub authored a replicates-dwelling commitment in steward_mutual mode; counter-commitment never arrived within grace_period_days, or was unilaterally revoked. Substrate emits this signal naming the breaching party. Standing-debit moderate.
